summary: Square Enix's Final Fantasy tactics subseries set around Ivalice, covering the original, the Advance/A2 branch, the mobile social entry, and the modern Ivalice Chronicles release.

entries.title: Final Fantasy Tactics
entries.definitive_edition: Final Fantasy Tactics: The Ivalice Chronicles on Windows, plus PSP War of the Lions for omitted extras

emulation.emulator: Native Windows; PPSSPP for PSP secondary content
emulation.notes: No emulation needed for the primary route. Use PPSSPP only for legally owned War of the Lions secondary content.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output for primary; PSP output with emulator scaling for secondary.

primary.version: Final Fantasy Tactics: The Ivalice Chronicles
primary.why: The Ivalice Chronicles is the modern high-fidelity release with enhanced graphics, full voice acting, refined gameplay, classic mode, and PC capture flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Play The Ivalice Chronicles on Windows/Steam for the main run; use the PSP War of the Lions version only for its omitted exclusive content.

secondary.exclusive_content: War of the Lions-specific content omitted from The Ivalice Chronicles, including extra guest characters/jobs and multiplayer-era material documented in version-difference sources.
secondary.what_to_play: Play or document the PSP War of the Lions-exclusive quests/characters/jobs and multiplayer-era features separately after the main Ivalice Chronicles run.
secondary.why: The PC remaster is the best main route, but it intentionally follows the original-game scope rather than including all PSP additions.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows Ivalice Chronicles is the best-looking main route, but PSP War of the Lions retains exclusive additions that are not included in the remaster.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Ivalice Chronicles modernizes the original-game scope and uses the War of the Lions translation, but it omits some PSP-exclusive additions.

entries.title: Final Fantasy Tactics Advance
entries.definitive_edition: Game Boy Advance original via mGBA or hardware capture

emulation.notes: Use mGBA or hardware capture with clean scaling.

primary.why: Tactics Advance is a Game Boy Advance title; later Wii U Virtual Console availability does not add content, so the original GBA game via high-quality capture/emulation is the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the GBA release on hardware, Analogue Pocket/MiSTer, or mGBA with clean scaling; Wii U Virtual Console is an availability route only.

all_releases.fidelity: Digital rerelease of the GBA version.
all_releases.reason: skip: availability route, no exclusive content over GBA.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The GBA version is the base game and the Virtual Console release does not add content.

entries.title: Final Fantasy Tactics A2: Grimoire of the Rift

emulation.notes: Use DS hardware capture or emulator scaling with legally dumped files.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Nintendo DS output with emulator scaling.

primary.why: Tactics A2 is documented as a Nintendo DS-only sequel to Tactics Advance, so the DS original is the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Nintendo DS/3DS hardware with capture, or use a DS emulator such as melonDS or DeSmuME with legally dumped files.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only one official platform is documented.

entries.title: Final Fantasy Tactics S

emulation.notes: Mobile emulation does not solve a service dependency; verify any archival route before coverage.

primary.why: Tactics S was a mobile social game released for iOS/iPadOS and Android; no current official play route was found in the consulted public sources.
primary.how_to_play: Treat as a historical service-game entry unless an official playable client/server route is documented; do not plan a normal live playthrough.

all_releases.reason: primary: first documented mobile route, now historical.
skip: same service-game content, no separate current route documented.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Completeness depends on historical service availability; no current official play route was found.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service/social mobile title; likely not playable through normal official means now.
